Cookie notice

Information about cookies, browser storage and external services used with this website.

Last updated: 20 November 2026

Privacy policyCookie noticeLegal notice & terms

Website features

The NBK website code does not set analytics, advertising or preference cookies, and does not use localStorage or sessionStorage. It has no embedded maps, third-party video players, advertising pixels or analytics trackers. Photos and videos are served from the same website host; native playback does not add a third-party media embed. The enquiry composer operates locally and opens an email app; it does not store the enquiry in an NBK website database.

Hosting and private preview

Hosting and security infrastructure may use technical cookies or similar mechanisms to deliver and protect the site. The private ChatGPT preview also uses authentication and session mechanisms supplied by the platform. These are separate from NBK’s website code. Their exact names and lifetimes depend on the platform and your session; consult OpenAI’s cookie policy and Cloudflare’s privacy policy.

External fonts and email

Google Fonts supplies the typefaces and receives technical request information. A font request is an external network connection, even though this site does not add an analytics tracker. Your email application is opened only when you use an email link or submit the enquiry composer; it operates under your provider’s own privacy and storage settings.

Your choices

You can manage or delete cookies and site data in your browser settings. Blocking essential platform cookies may prevent access to the private preview. No optional analytics or advertising tools have been added, so there is no optional tracking preference to select in this version. If such tools are introduced, the notice and any legally required consent controls must be updated before activation.

Contact

For questions, email info@nbkdiesel.com. See the Privacy policy for personal information and rights.
